name: Infernal Mages

variantInfo.name: Infernal Mage
notes: Standard combat level 66 Infernal Mage (npc 443-447); the Slayer-task target requiring 45 Slayer.
60 Hitpoints, max hit 8, 4-tick Magic attack (magic level 75); Protect from Magic negates their attack completely.
Defence level 60 with all melee and ranged defensive bonuses 0 and +40 magic defence, so melee is the standard kill.
The superior variant is the Malevolent Mage.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower (first floor)
notes: Infernal Mages occupy the first floor of the Slayer Tower (Morytania); the monster page lists ~15 spawn tiles.
Reach the area via the south-east stairs; 60 Slayer and 61 Agility allow a shortcut past aggressive Aberrant spectres (wear a Nose peg or Slayer helmet).
Without the shortcut the route passes aggressive Banshees, so Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet are recommended; 18 Agility allows the broken-window shortcut to the stairs.
Cannons cannot be placed anywhere in the Slayer Tower (a strange magical force prevents it), so cannonable is false.

taskNotes: Infernal Mages are assigned only by Vannaka (40-90 per task, weighting 8) and require 45 Slayer; Vannaka additionally gates assignment at combat level 40 and completion of Priest in Peril (needed to enter Morytania / the Slayer Tower).
Assignment data (masterIds, amountByMaster, weightByMaster) was verified against the raw wikitext of Vannaka's task table on 2026-07-03.
Chaeldar (8 May 2024, Project Rebalance) and Duradel (10 September 2015, Slayer Assignment Rework) no longer assign Infernal Mages, so Vannaka is the sole current assigner.
There is no dedicated Slayer_task/Infernal Mages wiki page (missing); combat and location facts were taken from the Infernal Mage monster page (pageid 12370, revid 15199194, 2026-04-28T07:11:57Z).

Infernal Mage has 60 Hitpoints, max hit 8, a 4-tick Magic attack (magic level 75), Defence level 60, and defensive bonuses of 0 to all melee and ranged styles with +40 magic defence; weakness.style is MELEE because melee has no defensive resistance and the monster page lists no elemental weakness.
Protect from Magic negates their accurate magic attack completely; they are immune to weak burns.
npc IDs are 443-447; the superior variant is the Malevolent Mage (not authored here).
No task extension unlock exists for Infernal Mages.
slayerTargetId 284 is SYNTHETIC (unused in-range placeholder); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
No Slayer_task/Infernal Mages page exists; wikiPageId 12370 pins the Infernal Mage monster page (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Mage) instead.
recommendedMethod: Travel to the first floor of the Slayer Tower (Priest in Peril required for Morytania access) and kill Infernal Mages with melee - they have no melee or ranged defensive bonuses (+40 magic defence). They cast an accurate Magic attack (max hit 8, magic level 75), so use Protect from Magic to negate all incoming damage, or safespot them. Bring Earmuffs/Nose peg or a Slayer helmet for the aggressive Banshees and Aberrant spectres on the route.
